feature_descriptions.Invocations: Invocation uses, save DC, and currently selected invocation are tracked by the shared class-resource system.
feature_descriptions.Forbidden Lore: The current caster-level bonus and the optional activation state are derived from Thaumaturge level.

resources.name: Invocations
resources.description: Daily uses equal half Thaumaturge level plus casting ability modifier. Select the invocation used before spending a use.

resources.name: Forbidden Lore
resources.description: Caster-level increase for the current effect. Enable while resolving a use; backlash is checked separately and its cumulative penalty lasts until the next spell-point recovery.

resources.name: Invocation Save DC
resources.description: 10 + half Thaumaturge level + casting ability modifier.

choice_providers.label: Master Invoker
choice_providers.description: At 20th level choose two invocations other than Rebuke Death to use without spending invocation uses.

notes: Spell points remain authoritative in the shared sphere service. Forbidden Lore, invocations, Occult Knowledge, bonus feats, and Master Invoker use shared declarations.
